name: Coinbosa
short_description: Coinbosa Chain is an EVM-compatible network with a fixed supply of 700,000,000 BOSA and 5-second blocks.
description: Coinbosa Chain is an EVM-compatible blockchain operated by coinbosa, Inc. (Delaware). The native coin BOSA has 18 decimals and a fixed supply of 700,000,000, allocated entirely in the genesis block with no programmed emission. The network uses Parlia proof-of-staked-authority consensus with 5-second blocks and is currently operated by a single validator, so it is not presented as decentralised. Token contracts follow the BRC20 standard, which is ERC-20 compatible.
